chapter_name: Chapter 09: Capital Letters and Full Stops
learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to properly start a sentence with a Capital Letter and end it with a Full Stop.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Choo-choo! 🚂 Every train needs a big engine at the front and a red light at the back to stop. Sentences are just like trains! Let's learn how to start and stop them properly.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🔠 The Engine: Capital Letters (बड़े अक्षर से शुरुआत)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Just like a train starts with a big engine, every written sentence must start with a Big Letter (Capital Letter).
When we finish saying something, we must tell the reader to stop! We do this by putting a small dot at the end. This dot is called a Full Stop (.).

lesson_modules.module_title: 🌟 Special Engine for Names (नामों के लिए बड़े अक्षर)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Special names of people, cities, or days are very important! They ALWAYS start with a Capital Letter, even if they are in the middle of a train (sentence). The letter 'I' alone is also always Capital.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ How should the first letter of a sentence be written?
❓ What is the small dot at the end of a sentence called?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rewrite this sentence correctly: 'the dog is barking'
subjective_practice.hint: Make the first letter Big, and put a dot at the end!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Find the mistake: 'my name is rohan.'
subjective_practice.hint: The first letter should be capital, AND special names like 'rohan' should also start with a capital letter.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add the missing Full Stop: 'I like to eat apples'
subjective_practice.hint: Put the tiny brake dot at the very end.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 The Punctuation Detective
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Open your favorite English storybook. Become a detective 🕵️! Point to 5 Capital Letters at the start of sentences and find 5 Full Stops at the ends.

chapter_summary: ⭐ Always start a new sentence with a Capital Letter.
⭐ Special names and the word 'I' always start with a Capital Letter.
⭐ Always put a Full Stop (.) at the end of a sentence.
